description: September 30 birthday meaning: Libra decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 30 birthday falls in Libra, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: September 30 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Closing the month, September 30 combines early Libra with the creative number 3. Seven degrees into the sign, Venus governs both sign and decan, encouraging warmth, style and a love of company. Thirty reduces to 3, linked with self-expression and play. The traditional portrait is a natural host and storyteller, at ease in conversation and rarely without an appreciative audience.

On September 30 the Sun usually sits at about 7° Libra, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. Libra's first decan, from about September 23 to October 2, holds Venus as both sign ruler and sub-ruler. This is traditionally the most graceful and relationship-minded part of the sign. Fairness, harmony and aesthetic sense are emphasised, along with a gift for making guests feel welcome. Those born here often weigh every side of a decision, which makes them good mediators and occasionally slow choosers. The doubled Venus influence can also lead to avoiding conflict at the cost of honesty. Growth often arrives with the discovery that a fair outcome sometimes requires an uncomfortable conversation first.

sections.heading: September 30 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 30 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on September 30: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 30 is the 273rd day of the year (274th in a leap year). By October 24, 24 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 30 include Monica Bellucci (1964), Elie Wiesel (1928) and Truman Capote (1924).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 30?
faq.answer: September 30 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Libra, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 30 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 30?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 30?
faq.answer: September 30 is also the birthday of Monica Bellucci (1964), Elie Wiesel (1928) and Truman Capote (1924). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
